sponsors.name: College Pro
sponsors.description: College Pro is an entrepreneurial franchise that allows students to operate their own home servicing businesses, focusing on sales, operations, and people management. They are a valued sponsor of the WSC that contributes through our guest speaker panels to bring valuable insight and opportunitiesto our members.

sponsors.name: Vantage Marketing
sponsors.description: Vantage Marketing is a full-service marketing agency that specializes in helping small businesses grow. They are a valued sponsor of the WSC that contributes through our guest speaker panels to bring valuable insight and opportunitiesto our members.

sponsors.name: Kick AI
sponsors.description: Kick AI puts the power of professional performance monitoring in your hands, measuring and fine-tuning every move for maximum results. Serving as a virtual coach, they provide the insights needed to turn passion into measurable progress for athletes of all levels.

sponsors.name: DRT Cyber Security
sponsors.description: DRTCyber is a cybersecurity consulting firm that provides services to small and medium-sized businesses. They are a valued sponsor of the WSC that contributes through our guest speaker panels, and to provide our members with unique networking opportunities.

sponsors.name: Tethos Organization
sponsors.description: Tethos, formerly Tech for Social Impact, is a student-led organization providing software and hardware technology solutions to support non-profit organizations. We continue to collaborate with them, as they help our clients with their tech-needs.

sponsors.name: Emerald
sponsors.description: Emerald Advisors assists businesses with buy and sell-side transactions, providing comprehensive valuation services and marketing materials. Featured by the Ivey Business School, they offer mentorship and pro-bono M&A advisory services to lower middle-market businesses.

sponsors.name: OG Pressure Washing
sponsors.description: OG Pressure washing is a local business that specializes in residential pressure washing. Run by our very own Co-Founder and Vice President of Events, Owen Gerrard, OG Pressure Washing exemplifies the leadership and entrepreneurship WSC fosters.
